7.2.20.3.8 Trigger: T_CC_STOPPED_TIMEOUT
[SWS_CanSM_00445]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Can_01142, SRS_Can_01145
⌈After a timeout of CANSM_MODEREQ_REPEAT_TIME (ref. to [ECUC_CanSM_00336])
for all supposed controller stopped mode indications (ref. to [SWS_CanSM_00444]),
this condition shall trigger the sub state machine CANSM_BSM_DeinitPnSupported
of the respective network with T_CC_STOPPED_TIMEOUT.⌋
